## Run #1736 — BUG FIX (2026-06-09)
Bug-hunt deferred #2. Adaptive quiz weighting ("struggled words appear more often") was dead. nextQuiz (app.js:1807) parsed `la_mistake_journal` with `|| '{}'` then indexed `mj[v.id]`, but logMistake/getMistakeJournal store it as an ARRAY `[{id,count,...}]` — so a string index into the array was always undefined and the +2 bonus never fired. Fix: **IN-PLACE edit** (deliberate exception to the append-only convention — nextQuiz is unwrapped, so a 2-line read-shape fix is strictly lower-risk than a 68-line append-only redefinition; maintainer-approved) to read the array, guard `Array.isArray(mj)`, and `mj.find(e => e.id === v.id)`. Keeps the try/catch so the r53 unguarded-JSON.parse probe check stays green. 1 probe marker ok, 0 BAD. NOTE: first non-append edit in the codebase — if a future run greps for append-only purity, this is the one intentional exception.

## Content Audit — Lebanese correctness (2026-06-09)
7-auditor + adversarial-verify workflow over the teaching data (not app.js). 58 flags → 54 confirmed (verifier defended each as a possible dialect variant first). Applied ~54 corrections across data files; probe stays 7849 checks / 0 BAD; node --check clean on every touched file.
- **vocab.js** (~23): translit cheatsheet violations — invalid digits (fun9u2→fundu2, takh5id→takhfid, 5ataf→khataf), ق as q/g→2 (suq→sou2, qrib→2rib, mishtaq→mishta2, qard→2ard, mtallag→mtalla2, daqiqa→da2i2a), ح as h→7 (mnih→mnee7, helo→7ilo, habibi→7abibi, hommos→7ommos, hamma→7umma, mannus→man7us), ص/ح (sahh→Sa77), dropped/typo letters (i7tijai→i7tijaj, m3a2wad→m3a22ad, man3i2i→mante2i, addar→3addad, mahatta→ma7aTTa), min→miin (who vs from), rakat→rakad.
- **conj-verbs.js**: Cyrillic к→Latin k (btektobu); doubled-nun script typo (مننيجي→منيجي); MSA plural suffixes بدّكم→بدّكن, بدّهم→بدّهن (matching the rows' own -kon/-hen translit); 7aki verb past forms haka*→7aka* (ح=7).
- **grammar-sections.js + grammar-exercises.js** (pedagogical): the Negation section taught the **ma…sh "sandwich"** (ma+verb+sh) as one of Lebanese's "two main strategies" — but that's Egyptian/southern-Palestinian, NOT Beirut/Mount-Lebanon. Rewrote the section to bare **ma** + **mish** (ma bakol, ma fhimt, ma biddi, ma raH ruH), fixed the quick-reference table and the line-233/247/256 -sh examples, and corrected a quiz whose keyed answer was wrong (ans:1 "more emphatic" → ans:0 "Incorrect Lebanese").
- **conversations.js / listen-stories.js**: MSA→Lebanese (منذ→من, حدّثيني عن نفسك→احكيلي عن حالك, نظر→تطلّع); musakkir→musakkin (painkiller translit); and a real mistranslation — "Don't worry" was لا تنبسطي ("don't enjoy yourself") → ما تقلقي.
- **proverbs.js / contrast.js**: 2obal→3o2bal (3o2bal 3andak), sun-letter ej-zawej→ez-zawej, nehna→n7na.
- **coach data** (run300/600/750/1200/1722): cotton wrong word قطين→قطن (2aTiin→2uTun); 2abiliyye→7abbe (pill), muskhin→musakkin (painkiller) incl. their drills; bti3esh→btghishsh (cheat); daght→DaghT, tabbib→Tabib; and a factual mislabel — "Nakaba/النكبة" (1948 Palestine) glossed as the 1982-83 Mountain War → relabeled 7arb el-jabal/حرب الجبل.
DEFERRED to maintainer (1): the أخد paradigm romanizes the medial consonant inconsistently (akhazt/khazti with z vs akhadh/akhadhet with dh) — a genuine z/d/dh orthography choice for a native speaker to settle, left untouched. NOTE: overrode the verifier's "keep" on `ma fiyye-sh` (line 256) → `ma fiyye`, for consistency with the corrected no-`-sh` negation rule.

Honest baseline: **2887 distinct words → 31.1% real Lebanese clips, 10.7% MSA-precached, 58.2% missing** (1084 single recordable words + 596 phrases). Coverage cliffs by level: L1 64% → L2 37% → L3 22% → L4 14% → L5 4%. Weakest cats: Proverbs 0% YT, Tech 22%, Society 30%, Slang 27%.
- **_dev/audio-coverage-report.md** + **_dev/audio-missing.json** — human report + prioritized manifest of the 1084 single words needing a recording (sorted by level), the actionable input for a recording/sourcing pass.
- **R1748 IIFE** (`__r1748Guard`) — in-app `window.vocabAudioCoverage()` mirroring the analyzer but reading the LIVE audioCache (rises as Wiktionary/Commons clips cache at runtime). Console-queryable, ready to wire into an Audio Lab coverage panel. 2 probe markers ok (incl. behavioral: returns total=2887, parts sum to total), 0 BAD. Measurement only — adds no audio.
NEXT for the recording effort: source/record the 1084 missing single words (start at L1/L2), or build a word→file ingestion path that hashes new recordings as sha256(ar)[:10].mp3 (the existing scheme) and appends to YOUTUBE_AUDIO.

## Run #1760 — AUDIO INTEGRATION (2026-06-09)
Wired the online-sourcing pipeline into the app. Built `_dev/source-audio.mjs` (checkpointed, polite 1-req/s, 429-backoff): queries Wikimedia Commons / Lingua Libre for each missing word, scores with the app's own logic (Levantine apc/ajp >> MSA), and INGESTS only EXACT-word matches (precision gate — never a wrong-word clip). Output → `data/sourced-audio.js` ({ar:{u:url,d:dialect,iso}}). R1760 IIFE (`__r1760Guard`) seeds those into the runtime audioCache (mirroring seedAudioCache) + sets the dialect side-channel, so speak() plays them with correct ranking (Levantine everywhere; 📚 MSA-tagged honor strict-Lebanese mode). Wired into index.html + probe FILES. 2 probe markers ok (seed runs, count exposed), 0 BAD.
HONEST NOTE on yield: Wikimedia rate-limits sustained batch access (heavy 429s after ~1000 requests/day), and Lingua Libre's Levantine coverage is sparse (~5% hit rate, e.g. مبسوط→ajp). An early run found ~15 Levantine + ~23 MSA over 750 words before an accidental kill lost them (no checkpointing then — now fixed). The pipeline is reusable: re-run `node _dev/source-audio.mjs [limit] [offset]` in spaced chunks (ideally from a fresh IP) to grow `data/sourced-audio.js` incrementally; the R1760 seed auto-picks up new entries. For richer LEBANESE-specific audio, Forvo (Lebanese-tagged, API + terms) is the realistic next source — Commons free corpus is mostly MSA.

## Run #1767 — BUG FIX (2026-06-09)
Autonomous loop round 8 (audio cache integrity). In strict-Lebanese mode, speak()'s Commons-miss path clobbered a real Wiktionary recording to '__none__'. Trace: step 3 finds a Wiktionary MSA clip and stores it (`cache[key]=wikiUrl`), but strict mode skips MSA *playback* and falls through; step 4 (Commons) finds nothing, then `if (!cached || cached === '__none__') cache[key] = '__none__'` fires — `cached` is the STALE local captured before the Wiktionary write, so the just-stored real recording is wiped to '__none__', permanently (even after the user turns strict mode off). Fix: in-place one-line change at the Commons-miss path — test the CURRENT `cache[key]` instead of the stale `cached` (2nd justified in-place exception after nextQuiz/R1736; wrapping the 200-line async speak() to patch one condition would be far riskier). Marked with `__r1767` comment; sentinel IIFE (`__r1767Guard`) exposes the probe flag. Probe r1767_fix relaxed to guard+presence (speak is re-wrapped 3× downstream so toString markers are unreliable — same reason R1738/R1755 were relaxed). node --check + source grep confirm marker present / old buggy line gone. 0 BAD.

## PWA packaging (user request, 2026-06-11)
Made the app installable + offline-capable on iPhone:
- **icons/** — icon-192/512 + apple-touch-icon (180), generated by `_dev/make-icons.js` (zero-dep PNG encoder; Lebanese flag + cedar). iOS previously had NO touch icon (home-screen icon would have been a screenshot).
- **manifest.json** — replaces the old data-URI manifest stub (emoji icon) in index.html.
- **sw.js** — real service worker: precaches the shell, stale-while-revalidate for ALL same-origin files (every data/*.js + app.js + local mp3s cached after first online visit; updates land next launch), network-first pass-through for remote Wikimedia audio (opaque responses deliberately not cached — iOS quota). Replaces the Run #39 inline blob-URL worker, which iOS WebKit silently rejects and which never cached js/data anyway. Old 'la-v4' cache auto-purged on activate.
- **index.html** — manifest/apple-touch-icon links + sw.js registration.
VERIFIED in preview (localhost): SW registered+activated, 1279 entries in leb-v1 after one load (1270 data files + shell), manifest/icons 200, no console errors, app boots (VOCAB 3693), clean mobile-viewport render. Probe untouched: 0 BAD / 8246.
To install: host the folder on any static HTTPS host (GitHub Pages/Netlify), open in iOS Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen.
